name: Tosculi
heading: Tosculi (Hiveless) Traits and Alternate Racial Traits
distinctions: Sivi uses the standard Hiveless traits and retains gliding and Stalker.

The 2015 5e player rules give a minimum AC and a 1d4 slashing claw. They are distinct from the Pathfinder Advanced Races profile, the later Southlands Player’s Guide and the Tome of Beasts NPC stat blocks.
The claw entry lists a damage die; the NPC applies the standard melee Strength modifier to the roll.

name: Jinnborn
heading: Jinnborn Traits, Speaker Jinnborn and Shaper Jinnborn
distinctions: All four siraati are options within this playable species. Narel combines Earth siraati with the Shaper subrace for acid resistance and Elemental Strike.
Jinnborn are descendants of jinn, distinct from playable monster progressions for Djinni and Efreeti.

name: Kijani
heading: Kijani Traits
distinctions: The playable Kijani is a Plant. Contained Fury requires fewer than half maximum HP.
Speak with plants starts at character level 7. The level 2 example has access to Kijani’s other printed traits.
Kijani is the 2016 plantfolk profile, distinct from Piney and Wilden.
